set.body: Implement terminal evaluation for in-memory roots over ViewPlan and PullbackProgram. value resolves the route and demand, compiles or reuses one operator, executes once, and memoizes successful results under explicit immutable cache keys; materialize creates a new root in the current domain and clears the pending spatial plan. Acceptance: repeated identical value requests do not recompile or recompute; distinct demand or policy cannot alias incorrectly; failures never poison caches; materialized descendants route from the new root; execution remains inspectable and portable; JVM and JS tests cover cache and materialization laws.
set.title: Spatial lazy evaluator: value, result memoization, and materialize-to-root
